  Scenario: AC3 A value outside LOV-SCOPE or an empty required field is refused 422 and nothing is written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a role "RW-CASEOWN" with scope "OWN"
    When the security administrator posts a scope value outside LOV-SCOPE
    Then the system answers 422 with MSG-GEN-001 naming the field and writes no row, entry or event

  Scenario: AC4 A stale If-Match version is answered 409 and an unknown or inactive role 404, with nothing written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a role "RW-CASEOWN" at its current version
    When the security administrator posts a change with a stale If-Match version or a role code that does not exist or is inactive
    Then the system answers 409 for the stale version or 404 for the unknown or inactive role and writes nothing

  Scenario: AC5 A change is not stored when the decision-record library answers 503 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision-record library answers 503
    When the security administrator posts a valid scope change
    Then the change is not stored, the role keeps its value in force and the answer is 503 with MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC6 A refusal whose entry cannot be written is answered 503 and the record is not returned (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a case owned by another team and the decision-record library answers 503
    When a case owner with scope Team opens it
    Then the system answers 503 with MSG-P7-003 and does not return the record

  Scenario: AC7 A consumer answers 503 when the access owner misses the 2 s budget (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the access owner does not answer inside the 2 s budget while the consumer builds its predicate
    When a case owner lists cases
    Then the consumer answers 503 with MSG-GEN-006 and never answers a record it could not bound
